annotations.v1-a1: This hymn is a plea on someone else's behalf. In the *Rāmacaritamānasa*, a proud pupil sat
annotations.v1-a2: Is *Īśāna* a name being called out, or part of a description? Most printings leave a space
annotations.v1-a3: Three words in a row begin with *nir-*, 'without': without qualities (*guṇa*), without div
annotations.v1-a4: Two skies in one word. *Cid-ākāśa* is a sky made of consciousness: awareness as wide, empt
